name: Resurgis: Rise of the Dead
description:
About This Game

Resurgis is a third-person action game that merges unforgiving souls-like combat with a fast-paced rogue-lite progression system. Test your reflexes, forge your unique combat style, and carve your path for vengeance through a dark, blood-soaked dungeon loop.

Weighty Combat & Brutal Executions The combat system is built entirely on patience, timing, and pure carnage. Parry incoming attacks, dodge lethal blows, and punish your enemies with heavy, satisfying sword strikes. Paint the battlefield red with gory finishers that cleave weakened enemies into pieces.

Forge Your Own Playstyle Survive by conquering the dungeon room by room. After clearing a room, open the chest and choose one of three cards (Attack, Energy, or Parry focused) to complement your strategy. Every run offers a unique experience with different enemy layouts, mini-bosses, merchants, and endless build combinations.

Death is Just the Beginning Falling in this merciless world is not the end. The souls you harvest from slaughtered enemies stay with you even in death. Return to the hub, spend your hard-earned souls on the skill tree for permanent upgrades, and dive back into the depths deadlier than ever.

Unravel a Dark Secret You were resurrected to eradicate evil spirits. Yet, as you delve deeper and spill more blood, you will realize something is terribly wrong. The entities that pulled you back to the mortal realm might not be as innocent as they seem.

Dismember Your Foes with Ruthless Executions

Death is Only a New Beginning

The souls you gather do not abandon you in death. Use them at ancient altars to empower your character, transcend your limits, and return to the dungeons stronger than ever before.

Build Your Abilities Around Your Playstyle
short_desc: Resurgis is a 3D dark fantasy action game blending souls-like combat with rogue-lite dungeon crawling. Dismember your enemies with brutal finishers, draft cards in every room to build your unique playstyle, and master a relentless loop where death is only the beginning.
